label: TOPIK: test rounds offered each year
appliesTo: Anyone planning a TOPIK sitting around an admission or status deadline
why: How many chances a year exist decides whether a missed round costs weeks or a semester. Set by the annual implementation plan, so it is re-announced every year rather than fixed in law.

history.source: Study in Korea / TOPIK annual implementation plan
history.note: For 2026 the plan indicates PBT in January, April, May, July, October and November; IBT in February, March, June, September, October and November; and the separate Speaking test in March, June and October. Value records the PBT and IBT count. Always read the current year plan for the exact dates.
